answer: Require every agent to stake a small deposit into a shared kernel of trust before it can trade: the deposit is locked in an escrow that peers can slash if the agent is caught cheating. A lone honest agent climbs one ridge of reputation at a time, while a Sybil farmer must fund a separate deposit for each fake identity and maintain a full atlas of fake histories to look real. Forging a thousand credible identities therefore costs a thousand deposits plus constant upkeep, which makes mass fakery unprofitable while honest newcomers pay only once.
